blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Deliberate monochromatic blue palette on dark background with clear typographic hierarchy and efficient grid layout, but the color scatter panel dots are tiny and hard to read at render size, and panel labels (#777) nearly disappear.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Both circle-size encodings correctly use scaleSqrt, the bar chart y-domain starts at 0 with data-driven max, hardcoded hue [0,360] and lightness [0,100] axes are semantically exact for those color channels, and the fixed y-scale in the timeline updater honestly compares filtered counts against the full-dataset baseline.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces renders, but bitFilter.set iterates all 34K blocks synchronously on every brush mousemove — heavy CPU work is not deferred — and captured x/y scales become stale on window resize with no ResizeObserver.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-linked views (timeline, 60-node network, color scatter, block list) stay manageable — single-hue network with opacity falloff controls density, force layout is pre-computed so no animation chaos, and the grid layout groups views intuitively; main risk is that the color scatter's dense dot cloud and the network's 60-node hairball demand hover to resolve detail, but neither overwhelms at a glance.
